description: Grow and shrink an agent fleet by GCP VMs with one command each way: `fleet_host.py add <name>` creates a private (Tailscale + IAP only), agentic-vps-hardened Compute Engine host with a full lane toolchain, per-host revocable credentials and a T3 server, and `remove <name>` drains it, saves unfinished work, revokes every credential with proof and deletes everything it created. Dry run by default; every step idempotent and re-runnable after a partial failure; all deployment specifics in one template file. USE WHEN adding heavy build/verify capacity to an agent fleet, spinning up or tearing down a cloud dev host for coding agents, "add a GCP host", "remove the fleet host", "grow/shrink the fleet", "mint per-host credentials", "revoke a host's tokens", or auditing that a removed host left nothing behind. NOT FOR hardening an existing non-GCP box (agentic-vps), one-off GPU jobs (remote-gpu, colab-remote), or Kubernetes/managed runners. Triggers on "fleet host", "add host", "remove host", "gcp fleet", "fleet_host", "grow the fleet".
